verdict.rationale: The evidence shows on-demand capabilities only. Evaluators score experiment results automatically when an experiment is run, and Phoenix Intelligence is a built-in agent you hand investigations to. Nothing documents user-configured automations that run on a recurring schedule or trigger, such as scheduled or online evals or monitors that run unattended in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
